verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a game engine, since engines can ship AI assistants, so this is not 'na'. The evidence shows Bevy is a code-first Rust ECS engine with no first-party natural-language interface. Probes show no llms.txt and no official MCP; the only related tooling is the nascent community project bevy_brp, which wraps the Remote Protocol rather than providing natural-language control.
